Chevron's net cash provided by operating activities rose about 27.3% from fiscal Q1 2024 to fiscal Q4 2024.

- **Q1 2024:** the Q1 2025 10-Q reports $6,828 million for the three months ended March 31, 2024.
- **Q4 2024:** no Q4 figure is reported directly, so I derived it. Full-year 2024 operating cash flow was $31,492 million and the nine months ended September 30, 2024 was $22,797 million, giving $31,492 − $22,797 = $8,695 million.
- **Change:** ($8,695 − $6,828) / $6,828 = $1,867 / $6,828 ≈ 27.3%.
